reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch Re-Harden (mat_g2_na_q1_6), 2026-08-18

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The sample set fully addresses all three clauses of the MATATAG learning competency for 3-digit numbers. First, finding the digit given place value is tested in questions such as "In 135, what digit is in the ones place?" (seed 42) and "In 752, what digit is in the hundreds place?" (seed 501). Second, identifying the place value / place of a digit is tested in "What place is the digit 1 in, in the number 195?" (seed 43) and "What place is the digit 0 in, in the number 260?" (seed 46). Third, determining the value of a digit is tested in items such as "What is the place value of the digit 3 in 320?" (seed 44) and "In the number 610, the value of the digit 1 in the tens place is 11. True or False?" (seed 50).

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The samples provide balanced coverage across all digit positions (hundreds, tens, ones) and target skills. The ones position is represented in "In 135, what digit is in the ones place?" (seed 42) and "In 847, what digit is in the ones place?" (seed 502). The tens position is represented in "What is the place value of the digit 8 in 285?" (seed 45) and "What is the place value of the digit 6 in 160?" (seed 602). The hundreds position is represented in "What is the place value of the digit 2 in 250?" (seed 600) and "In the number 831, the value of the digit 8 in the hundreds place is 18. True or False?" (seed 500). Furthermore, numbers with zeros in terminal and internal positions are included (e.g., 320, 260, 610, 250, 405, 160).

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The linguistic complexity and cognitive load are perfectly tuned for Grade 2 Quarter 1 learners. The sentences are concise and direct without unnecessary filler words, as seen in "In 135, what digit is in the ones place?" (seed 42) and "What is the place value of the digit 3 in 320?" (seed 44). Verification tasks are clear and unambiguous, such as "What place is the digit 4 in, in the number 405? The answer is hundreds. True or False?" (seed 601).

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The generator utilizes multiple diverse formatters and problem structures, including multiple-choice questions ("In 847, what digit is in the ones place?", seed 502), fill-in-the-blank cloze prompts ("What place is the digit 0 in, in the number 260?", seed 46; "In 752, what digit is in the hundreds place?", seed 501), and true/false evaluation tasks ("In the number 610, the value of the digit 1 in the tens place is 11. True or False?", seed 50).

competency_alignment.rationale: All items strictly adhere to the MATATAG learning competency without scope creep or out-of-grade operations. No 4-digit numbers, expanded form expressions, or arithmetic operations are introduced. Every problem focuses solely on digit identification, place determination, or value calculation within 3-digit numbers, as illustrated by "What is the place value of the digit 8 in 285?" (seed 45) and "In 752, what digit is in the hundreds place?" (seed 501).

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All target numbers are strictly 3-digit whole numbers within 100-999 (e.g., 135, 195, 320, 285, 260, 610, 831, 752, 847, 250, 405, 160), exactly matching the MATATAG Grade 2 Quarter 1 domain for 3-digit numbers. Place values and digit values correspond correctly to ones (0-9), tens (10-90), and hundreds (100-900), as demonstrated in "What is the place value of the digit 2 in 250?" (seed 600) and "What is the place value of the digit 6 in 160?" (seed 602).
